text: dsh-system-notify 是一款面向 DSH 的桌面通知插件，通过监听会话、目标、审批和问题事件，在任务完成、出错或需要处理时显示系统通知并播放提示音。它提供可配置的事件开关、通知样式、静音时段、音效和点击唤起，并可在支持的平台上直接从通知回应审批或问题；设置页可调整选项，Agent 工具可选启用。适合希望离开终端或等待长任务时及时了解 DSH 状态的用户。需要本机桌面通知后端及相应平台组件；不要求 API 密钥。

dsh-system-notify sends desktop alerts and sounds for DSH task completion, errors, questions, and approvals. Configure events, styles, quiet hours, and click-to-focus; answer some requests in notifications. Includes a settings page and optional agent alerts. Needs a local notification backend.
我想在长任务结束或出错时收到电脑桌面提醒。
能不能直接从系统弹窗批准工具调用或回答问题？
I want desktop alerts when a DSH task finishes or needs my attention.
dsh-system-notify 的功能「事件桌面提醒」：监听任务完成、错误、问题、审批和目标变化等事件，按设置生成系统通知与提示音。可配置事件、通知样式、静音时段和投递方式。
dsh-system-notify 的功能「通知内交互」：在支持的平台上，可从通知直接批准或拒绝工具请求，也可选择或输入回答；不支持或超时的操作交回 DSH 聊天界面。

dsh-system-notify README · dsh-system-notify：Codex-style desktop notifications for **DeepSeek Harness**: a toast and a sound when a task finishes, fails, needs your input, or a goal completes — with configurable events, sounds, notification style, privacy level, quiet hours and click-to-focus.

Built for **Windows 10/11** and **Ubuntu 22.04/24.04** (best-effort macOS support).

[](https://github.com/JamesYasR/dsh-system-notify/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

dsh-system-notify README · Why not just a `notify` script?：| | Codex-style notify script | dsh-system-notify |
|---|---|---|
| Turn complete | ✅ | ✅ with summary, project, duration |
| Turn error | ⚠️ manual scripting | ✅ with error message/code |
| Questions / approvals | ❌ | ✅ “Input needed” / “Approval needed” |
| Goal completed / blocked | ❌ | ✅ |
| Subagent / workflow finished | ❌ | ✅ optional |
| Notification style | ❌ | ✅ privacy / simple / standard / detailed |
| Sound selection | ❌ | ✅ system / chime / alert / custom WAV/OGG |
| Quiet hours & cooldown | ❌ | ✅ |
| Click to focus DSH | ❌ | ✅ configurable |
| Settings UI | ❌ | ✅ Settings → System Notifications |
dsh-system-notify README · Why not just a `notify` script?：Everything is local. No network calls, no telemetry, no data leaves the machine.

dsh-system-notify README · Features：- **11 notification events** — turn complete/error/blocked/max-tokens/aborted, input needed, approval needed, goal complete/blocked, subagent finished, workflow finished.
- **Four styles** — privacy (event only), simple, standard, detailed.
- **Interactive approvals** — approve or reject a tool call directly on the toast; the outcome is returned to DSH.
- **Interactive questions** — choose a listed option from the toast, pick from a checklist for multi-select, or type a custom answer in an input dialog.
- **Custom sounds per event** — upload a WAV/OGG from the settings page (stored beside the config); separate files for normal and error events, plus the two bundled sounds.
- **Sound** — system sound, two bundled original chimes, or your own file; separate normal/error sounds; volume on Ubuntu.
- **Delivery modes** — toast + sound, toast only, or sound only.
- **Quiet hours** — suppress normal notifications overnight, optionally still notify on critical errors.
- **Rate control** — minimum task duration, per-event cooldown, optional subagent-session filtering.
- **Click to focus** — on Windows the toast uses DSH Desktop's official `dsh://open` dee

dsh-system-notify README · Notification styles：Given this event:

```text
kind=turnComplete
session=Refactor the settings page
project=D:\workspace\demo
summary="Finished the settings page and verified save / test / sound."

dsh-system-notify README · Notification styles：| Style | What you see |
|---|---|
| **Privacy** (隐私) | Title only: `Task completed` — no session, summary, path or error details. |
| **Simple** (简洁) | `Task completed` · `Refactor the settings page` |
| **Standard** (标准) | Title + session + summary + `demo · took 1m 12s` |
| **Detailed** (详细) | Title includes session + summary + full path + `turn 3 · took 1m 12s · code …` |
dsh-system-notify README · Notification styles：Errors are always delivered with `critical` urgency (Linux) and the error sound; privacy mode still hides the message content.

dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu：Install the notification and sound helpers (most desktops have some of them already):

```bash
sudo apt install libnotify-bin libglib2.0-bin pulseaudio-utils wmctrl
```

dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu：- `libnotify-bin` provides `notify-send` (fallback when `gdbus` is unavailable).
- `libglib2.0-bin` provides `gdbus` and `dbus-monitor` — **required for clickable notifications**.
- `pulseaudio-utils` provides `paplay` (PipeWire systems usually provide `pw-play`; both are supported).
- `wmctrl` (or `xdotool`) is used to focus the DSH window on click. Without it, clicking falls back to opening the configured link.
- `zenity` is used for interactive text input and multi-choice dialogs. Install it with `sudo apt install zenity`; without it those flows fall back to the Chat UI (direct option buttons still work).

dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu：Clickable notifications use the standard `org.freedesktop.Notifications` DBus interface: `gdbus` raises the notification with a `default` action, and `dbus-monitor` listens for `ActionInvoked`.

dsh-system-notify README · macOS (best effort)：`osascript` displays notifications and `afplay` plays sounds. Click-to-focus requires [`terminal-notifier`](https://github.com/julienXX/terminal-notifier) (`brew install terminal-notifier`); without it notifications are display-only.

dsh-system-notify README · From GitHub：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:JamesYasR/dsh-system-notify
```

dsh-system-notify README · From a local checkout：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-system-notify
```

Or use the DSH Web UI: **Settings → Plugins → Install** and provide the GitHub spec or the local directory.

After installation open **Settings → System Notifications** (系统通知). The plugin is enabled by default. The settings page shows the detected backends and any missing OS packages.

dsh-system-notify README · Settings reference：The config lives at:

- Windows: `%APPDATA%\dsh-system-notify\config.json`
- Linux/macOS: `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dsh-system-notify/config.json` (default `~/.config/dsh-system-notify/config.json`)

Override the location with `DSH_SYSTEM_NOTIFY_CONFIG=/path/to/config.json`.

dsh-system-notify README · Windows：The toast is created with `activationType="protocol"` and `launch="dsh://open"`, plus an **Open DSH** action button. DSH Desktop registers that protocol and its single-instance handler restores, shows and focuses the primary window. This is the same path DSH itself uses for deep links, so it needs no extra registry keys or helper process from the plugin.

dsh-system-notify README · Windows：- Turn `click.enabled` off to make the toast non-clickable.
- Running DSH as a web app without Desktop? Set `click.url` to your DSH web URL; the click then opens that URL in the default browser.

dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu：If `gdbus` is missing, the plugin falls back to `notify-send`. If `dbus-monitor` is missing, `gdbus` still raises the notification but clicking it cannot be observed, so the toast is not clickable. If you use DSH in a browser on Ubuntu, set `click.focusWindowTitle` to something in the browser window title (e.g. `DeepSeek Harness`) and/or change `click.url` to the DSH URL. On Wayland, `wmctrl`/`xdotool` may be unavailable; the click then falls back to opening `click.url`.

dsh-system-notify README · Interactive notifications：When `interactive.enabled` is on (default), approval and single-question requests can be answered directly from the toast. The plugin briefly owns the request, shows the action UI, and returns the choice to DSH. If you do nothing for `interactive.timeoutSec` (default 20 s), choose **Open DSH**, privacy style is active, the delivery mode is sound-only, or a platform helper is missing, the request is delegated to the normal Chat UI — the same prompt you would have seen anyway.

dsh-system-notify README · Interactive notifications：| Request | On the notification |
|---|---|
| Tool approval | **Approve** / **Reject** / **Open DSH**; Approve returns `allowed-once`, Reject returns `rejected`. |
| Single choice question | One button per option (up to 3), **Choose…** for overflow, **Other…** for free text, **Open DSH**. |
| Multi-select question | **Choose…** opens a checklist, **Other…** opens text input, **Open DSH**. |
| Question without options | **Other…** opens a text input, **Open DSH**. |
| Multiple questions in one request | Falls back to the normal Chat UI. |

dsh-system-notify README · Windows mechanics：The plugin registers a per-user protocol handler under
`HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-system-notify` (no admin rights). Each button is an
`activationType="protocol"` action carrying a one-time interaction id + token and
the local DSH origin; `lib/responder.ps1` posts the choice to the same-origin
`/dsh-system-notify/respond` route. **Other…** opens a Windows input box;
**Choose…** opens a WinForms list/checklist. The protocol is removed when the
plugin is disabled or unloaded.

dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu mechanics：Clickable notifications use the freedesktop `ActionInvoked` signal (requires
`gdbus` + `dbus-monitor`). **Other…** and **Choose…** open `zenity` dialogs.
Direct option buttons work without zenity. Action visibility ultimately depends
on the notification daemon; GNOME may show fewer buttons for many-option
questions.

dsh-system-notify README · Security / behaviour：- Action ids are random per interaction and validated against the live pending
  set; a stale or forged action gets `410`.
- Interactive mode never triggers when notification style is **Privacy**, since
  option labels and question text are content.
- In-flight prompts are dismissed on timeout/abort, and the normal Chat prompt
  is opened instead.

dsh-system-notify README · Custom notification sounds：The settings page has **Choose file** buttons next to the normal/error sound
selectors. Uploaded files are validated by container magic and stored in:

```text
<config dir>/sounds/<kind>-<timestamp>-<random>.wav|ogg
```

dsh-system-notify README · Custom notification sounds：- Maximum 5 MiB; WAV on Windows, WAV/OGG on Ubuntu.
- Separate files for normal and error events; the legacy shared
  `sound.customPath` still works as a fallback.
- The file is stored locally; nothing is uploaded to the network. Remove old
  files from that directory manually if you no longer need them.
- **Preview sound** plays the current normal sound without saving.

dsh-system-notify README · Event sources：| Notification | DSH source |
|---|---|
| Turn completed / error / blocked / max-tokens / aborted | durable `turn/end` session event with its `reason` |
| Needs input | `user-questions/request` (notified before delegating to the normal answerer) |
| Approval needed | `approval/request` (notified before delegating) |
| Goal completed / blocked | `goal/changed` with operation `complete` / `block` |
| Subagent finished | `subagent/end` |
| Workflow finished | `workflow/end` |
| Custom | agent tool `send_desktop_notification` |

dsh-system-notify README · Event sources：Duplicate suppression: a question suppresses the immediately following `blocked` turn notification (60 s window), and a goal notification suppresses a redundant turn-complete toast (8 s window).

dsh-system-notify README · Privacy：- Notification content stays in process memory (the Windows payload is passed to the PowerShell helper through an environment variable) and in the OS toast. The plugin itself writes only the config file; Windows Notification Center may retain shown toasts according to OS settings.
- The config file is written with user-only permissions where the OS supports them (`0600`).
- **Privacy style** removes session titles, summaries, paths, session ids and error text from the notification. The event category and sound remain. Interactive prompts are disabled in privacy style because option labels and question text are content.
- Click URLs are validated against an allowlist (`http:`, `https:`, `dsh:`); `file:`, `javascript:`, `ms-msdt:` and other schemes are rejected.
- HTTP routes are same-origin only and reject a mismatched `Origin` header. Request bodies are capped at 256 KiB.

dsh-system-notify README · No toast on Windows：1. Check Windows **Settings → System → Notifications** — “DeepSeek Harness” must be allowed.
2. Check Focus Assist / Do Not Disturb. Toasts are queued in Notification Center rather than shown as banners in some modes.
3. Make sure the plugin is enabled and the event is checked.
4. The default toast AppID is `com.deepseek.dsh`, the AUMID registered by the DSH Desktop Start Menu shortcut. The helper falls back to other registered toast sources, ending at the always-registered PowerShell source. To pin another source, set `windows.appId` explicitly.

dsh-system-notify README · No sound on Windows：- Windows custom audio must be a local **WAV** file. OGG/MP3 will not play.
- Check the Windows volume mixer / output device.
- Use the settings page **Preview sound** button; if it works, the issue is the per-event sound choice.

dsh-system-notify README · No sound on Ubuntu：- Install `pulseaudio-utils` (`paplay`) or make sure `pw-play` exists.
- The bundled system sound is `/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga`; if that file is absent the plugin falls back to the bundled chime.

dsh-system-notify README · No notifications on Ubuntu：- `notify-send` needs a running notification daemon (GNOME Shell, KDE, dunst, mako…). Headless SSH sessions have none.
- Install `libnotify-bin`; the settings page shows the detected backend.

dsh-system-notify README · Click does not focus DSH：- Windows: DSH Desktop must be installed so the `dsh://` protocol exists. Test by opening `dsh://open` in the Start menu’s Run dialog.
- Ubuntu: install `wmctrl`/`xdotool` and `libglib2.0-bin`; confirm the window title contains `click.focusWindowTitle`.
- Browser-only DSH: set `click.url` to the DSH web URL.

dsh-system-notify README · Interactive buttons do nothing：- Confirm **Settings → System Notifications → Interactive notifications** is enabled and the event is checked.
- Windows: the settings page shows the protocol status. If it is `✗`, run the plugin while your user can write `HKCU\Software\Classes` (no admin needed), then reload the plugin.
- Ubuntu: install `libglib2.0-bin` (gdbus/dbus-monitor) and `zenity` for text/checklist dialogs.
- Option buttons may be hidden by a notification daemon that limits actions; **Open DSH** still works.
- After the timeout (default 20 s) DSH itself asks, so the agent is never left waiting.

dsh-system-notify README · Custom sound upload fails：- WAV only on Windows; WAV/OGG on Ubuntu; maximum 5 MiB.
- The file is verified by magic bytes, not by its extension.
- If the config directory is read-only, the upload returns an error; check the path shown at the bottom of the settings page.

dsh-system-notify README · Still stuck：- Enable the plugin, then use **Send test notification** / **Preview sound** in Settings.
- Inspect the config file path shown at the bottom of the settings page.
- Set `DSH_SYSTEM_NOTIFY_DRY_RUN=1` in the Host environment to log the computed payload instead of delivering it.
- Check the DSH host log for `[dsh-system-notify]` warnings.

dsh-system-notify README · Development：```bash
git clone https://github.com/JamesYasR/dsh-system-notify.git
cd dsh-system-notify
node --test          # unit tests: config, formatting, policy, interactive actions, payload builders, uploads
npm run verify       # syntax-check every runtime module

Install a local checkout as a bundle:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh-system-notify
```

Structure:

dsh-system-notify README · Development：```text
index.mjs              Host plugin: events, policy, routes, optional tool
lib/config.mjs         defaults, validation, persistence
lib/events.mjs         session/goal/interaction event collection + policy
lib/format.mjs         style/privacy/localization rendering

The delivery builders are pure and unit-tested on every platform; the Linux path is exercised in CI through payload/command tests (CI has no desktop session).

dsh-system-notify README · Limitations：- Interactive approval always answers `allowed-once` or `rejected`; there is no “always allow” button.
- Multiple questions in one request, or a notification daemon that hides actions, fall back to the Chat UI.
- macOS interactive actions are not supported; macOS gets normal notifications only.
- Windows notification volume is controlled by the system sound scheme; `sound.volume` applies to Ubuntu only.
- Windows custom sounds must be WAV; a successful upload is stored locally and referenced by absolute path.
- Clicking focuses the DSH window, not a specific session: DSH’s deep link is `dsh://open`.
- Linux click/interactive support depends on `gdbus`, `dbus-monitor`, and a notification daemon that implements the freedesktop spec; zenity is needed for text/checklist dialogs.
- The macOS path is best-effort and click support requires `terminal-notifier`.
- Toast banners may be suppressed by OS focus modes; this is expected system behaviour, not a plugin failure.

dsh-system-notify README · License：[MIT](LICENSE). The two bundled sound files are original works generated by `tools/generate-sounds.py` and are covered by the same license. The icon is original SVG/PNG artwork created for this project.

dsh-system-notify README · dsh-system-notify：给 **DeepSeek Harness** 的 Codex 风格桌面系统通知：任务完成、出错、需要输入、目标完成时弹出系统通知并播放提示音。可配置通知事件、音效、通知风格（隐私 / 简洁 / 标准 / 详细）、免打扰时段、点击唤起 DSH 窗口等。

支持 **Windows 10/11** 与 **Ubuntu 22.04/24.04**（macOS 为尽力支持）。

[](https://github.com/JamesYasR/dsh-system-notify/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[](LICENSE)

dsh-system-notify README · 为什么不用一个 notify 脚本？：Codex 只在每轮结束时执行一个 hook；本插件是事件驱动的：

| | Codex 风格 notify 脚本 | dsh-system-notify |
|---|---|---|
| 任务完成 | ✅ | ✅ 带摘要、项目、耗时 |
| 任务出错 | ⚠️ 需要自己写 | ✅ 带错误信息与错误码 |
| 需要输入 / 批准 | ❌ | ✅ |
| 目标完成 / 受阻 | ❌ | ✅ |
| 子任务 / 工作流完成 | ❌ | ✅ 可选 |
| 通知风格 | ❌ | ✅ 隐私 / 简洁 / 标准 / 详细 |
| 音效选择 | ❌ | ✅ 系统 / 清脆 / 警示 / 自定义 |
| 免打扰与冷却 | ❌ | ✅ |
| 点击唤起 DSH | ❌ | ✅ 可开关 |
| 图形设置页 | ❌ | ✅ 设置 → 系统通知 |

全部在本机完成，不联网、不上报、不把内容写到磁盘。
section: 为什么不用一个 notify 脚本？

text:
dsh-system-notify README · 功能：- **11 类通知事件**：轮次完成 / 出错 / 受阻 / 输出截断 / 取消、需要输入、需要批准、目标完成 / 受阻、子任务完成、工作流完成。
- **四种通知风格**：隐私（只显示事件类型）、简洁、标准、详细。
- **交互式审查**：可直接在通知上同意 / 拒绝工具调用，结果直接回传给 DSH。
- **交互式问答**：可直接点选通知上的选项；多选或选项过多时打开勾选列表；也可在输入框中填写自定义回答。
- **自定义音效**：设置页可上传 WAV/OGG（保存在配置目录旁），普通/错误事件可分别使用不同文件，并保留两个内置提示音。
- **音效**：系统默认、内置两个原创提示音、自定义文件；普通事件与错误事件可分别配置；Ubuntu 支持音量。
- **通知方式**：通知 + 音效、仅通知、仅音效。
- **免打扰时段**：夜间静音，可选择仍提醒严重错误。
- **频率控制**：最短任务时长、同类通知冷却、忽略子代理会话。
- **点击唤起**：Windows 使用 DSH 桌面版官方 `dsh://open` 深链；Ubuntu 通过 `wmctrl`/`xdotool` 聚焦窗口，找不到再打开链接。整个点击行为可关闭。
- **Agent 工具（可选）**：注册 `send_desktop_notification`，让 Agent 主动提醒你。
- **中英双语**：设置页跟随浏览器语言；通知文本可跟随系统或强制中文/English。
- **零运行时依赖**：只用 Node 内置模块和操作系统通知能力。

dsh-system-notify README · 通知风格示意：假设事件为：

```text
kind=turnComplete
会话=重构设置页
项目=D:\workspace\demo
摘要=设置页改造完成，已验证保存、测试通知与音效播放。

| 风格 | 通知内容 |
|---|---|
| **隐私** | 只有标题：`任务完成`，不显示会话名、摘要、路径、错误详情。 |
| **简洁** | `任务完成` · `重构设置页` |
| **标准** | 标题 + 会话名 + 摘要 + `demo · 耗时 1 分 12 秒` |
| **详细** | 标题带会话名 + 摘要 + 完整路径 + `第 3 轮 · 耗时 1 分 12 秒 · 错误码 …` |

错误事件始终使用 `critical` 紧急级别（Linux）与错误音效；隐私风格仍会隐藏错误正文。

dsh-system-notify README · Windows：- Windows 10（1809+）或 Windows 11。
- DSH 桌面版。插件使用：
  - PowerShell 5.1 + WinRT Toast（系统自带）；
  - DSH 桌面版 Start Menu 快捷方式注册的 Toast AppID `com.deepseek.dsh`（不可用时助手会回退到其他已注册 Toast 源，最后回退到 Windows PowerShell）；
  - DSH 桌面版的 `dsh://open` 协议实现点击唤起窗口；
  - 交互式同意/回答按钮使用的当前用户 `dsh-system-notify://` 动作协议，由插件自动注册。
- 自定义音效由 PowerShell 助手通过 `System.Media.SoundPlayer` 播放，必须是 **PCM WAV**；内置音效已是 WAV。
- 通知受 Windows 专注助手 / 勿扰模式影响。若没有弹窗，请检查“DeepSeek Harness”的通知权限。

dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu：安装通知与音频工具（多数桌面已自带一部分）：

```bash
sudo apt install libnotify-bin libglib2.0-bin pulseaudio-utils wmctrl
```

- `libnotify-bin`：提供 `notify-send`（`gdbus` 不可用时的回退）。
- `libglib2.0-bin`：提供 `gdbus` 与 `dbus-monitor`，**可点击通知必需**。
- `pulseaudio-utils`：提供 `paplay`（PipeWire 系统一般有 `pw-play`，同样支持）。
- `wmctrl`（或 `xdotool`）：点击时聚焦 DSH 窗口；没有时回退为打开链接。
- `zenity`：交互式通知的文本输入与多选对话框需要它。安装：`sudo apt install zenity`；没有时这些操作会回落到 DSH 界面，直接选项按钮仍可用。
dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu：可点击通知通过标准 `org.freedesktop.Notifications` DBus 接口实现：`gdbus` 发出带 `default` action 的通知，`dbus-monitor` 监听 `ActionInvoked`。
dsh-system-notify README · macOS（尽力支持）：`osascript` 显示通知、`afplay` 播放音效。点击唤起需要 [`terminal-notifier`](https://github.com/julienXX/terminal-notifier)（`brew install terminal-notifier`），否则仅显示通知。

dsh-system-notify README · 从 GitHub 安装：```bash

dsh-system-notify README · 从本地目录安装：```bash

安装后打开 **设置 → 系统通知**。插件默认启用；设置页顶部会显示检测到的后端和缺失的系统依赖。

- Windows：`%APPDATA%\dsh-system-notify\config.json`

dsh-system-notify README · Windows：Toast 使用 `activationType="protocol"`、`launch="dsh://open"`，并带一个“打开 DSH”按钮。DSH 桌面版注册了该协议，单实例回调会恢复、显示并聚焦主窗口。这与 DSH 自己的深链路径一致，插件不需要额外注册表项或常驻进程。

- 关闭 `click.enabled` 后通知不可点击。
- 如果用的是网页版 DSH，把 `click.url` 改成 DSH 的网页地址即可在点击时用浏览器打开。

dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu：`notify-send` 本身不支持点击回调，因此插件：

1. 用 `gdbus … Notify` 发出带 `default` action 的通知；
2. 启动一个临时的 `dbus-monitor` 监听该通知的 `ActionInvoked`；
3. 点击后先用 `xdotool` / `wmctrl` 按 `click.focusWindowTitle` 聚焦窗口，找不到再 `xdg-open <click.url>`。

如果系统没有 `gdbus`，会退回 `notify-send`；如果没有 `dbus-monitor`，`gdbus` 仍能发出通知但无法捕获点击，因此通知不可点击。如果 Ubuntu 上 DSH 跑在浏览器里，请把 `click.focusWindowTitle` 设为浏览器窗口标题包含的文字（例如 `DeepSeek Harness`），或者把 `click.url` 改成 DSH 网页地址。Wayland 下 `wmctrl`/`xdotool` 可能不可用，此时点击会回退为打开 `click.url`。

dsh-system-notify README · 交互式通知：开启 `interactive.enabled`（默认开启）后，审批请求和单问题请求可以直接在通知上回答。插件会短暂接管该请求，把选择回传给 DSH；如果在 `interactive.timeoutSec`（默认 20 秒）内没有操作、点击“打开 DSH”、使用隐私风格、仅音效模式，或平台组件缺失，就自动交回 DSH 的正常聊天界面，不会让 Agent 一直卡住。

| 请求类型 | 通知上的操作 |
|---|---|
| 工具审批 | **同意** / **拒绝** / **打开 DSH**；同意返回 `allowed-once`，拒绝返回 `rejected`。 |
| 单选问题 | 每个选项一个按钮（最多 3 个）、**选择…**（选项过多时）、**其他…**（自由输入）、**打开 DSH**。 |
| 多选问题 | **选择…** 打开勾选列表，**其他…** 打开输入框，**打开 DSH**。 |
| 无选项问题 | **其他…** 打开输入框，**打开 DSH**。 |
| 一次包含多个问题 | 回落到 DSH 正常聊天界面。 |

dsh-system-notify README · Windows 实现：插件在 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-system-notify` 注册当前用户的协议处理器（无需管理员权限）。按钮使用 `activationType="protocol"`，携带一次性 interaction id、token 和本地 DSH 地址；点击后由 `lib/responder.ps1` 把选择 POST 到 `/dsh-system-notify/respond`。**其他…** 弹出 Windows 输入框，**选择…** 弹出 WinForms 列表/勾选列表。插件禁用或卸载时会移除协议。
dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu 实现：通过 freedesktop `ActionInvoked` 接收点击（需要 `gdbus` + `dbus-monitor`）；**其他…** 与 **选择…** 使用 `zenity` 对话框。直接选项按钮不依赖 zenity。实际显示几个按钮取决于通知守护进程，GNOME 对选项很多的通知可能只显示部分操作。

dsh-system-notify README · 安全与行为：- interaction id/token 每次随机生成，由正在等待的请求集合校验；失效或伪造的操作返回 `410`。
- **隐私风格**下不会启用交互，因为选项标签和问题文本也属于内容。
- 超时/中止时会移除通知，并打开 DSH 正常提示，不会同时出现两个提示。

dsh-system-notify README · 自定义通知音效：设置页在普通/错误音效下拉框旁提供 **选择文件** 按钮。上传文件会校验容器头并保存到：

```text
<配置目录>/sounds/<kind>-<时间戳>-<随机>.wav|ogg
```

- 最大 5 MiB；Windows 仅 WAV，Ubuntu 支持 WAV/OGG。
- 普通事件与错误事件可以分别使用不同文件；旧版 `sound.customPath` 仍作为回退。
- 文件只保存在本机，不会上传到网络。不再需要时可直接删除该目录下的文件。
- **试听音效** 可直接预览当前普通音效，无需先保存。

dsh-system-notify README · 事件来源：| 通知 | DSH 来源 |
|---|---|
| 完成 / 出错 / 受阻 / 输出截断 / 取消 | 持久化的 `turn/end` 会话事件及其 `reason` |
| 需要输入 | `user-questions/request`（在交给正常回答者前通知） |
| 需要批准 | `approval/request`（在交给正常回答者前通知） |
| 目标完成 / 受阻 | `goal/changed`，operation 为 `complete` / `block` |
| 子任务完成 | `subagent/end` |
| 工作流完成 | `workflow/end` |
| 自定义 | Agent 工具 `send_desktop_notification` |

去重规则：刚问过问题后的 60 秒内不再发“受阻”；目标完成后的 8 秒内不再发重复的“任务完成”。

dsh-system-notify README · 隐私：- 通知内容只存在于进程内存（Windows 通过环境变量传给 PowerShell 助手）和系统弹窗中；插件自身除配置文件外不落盘，但 Windows 通知中心可能按系统设置保留已显示的通知。
- 配置文件在支持 POSIX 权限的系统上以 `0600` 写入。
- **隐私风格**会移除会话名、摘要、路径、会话 ID 和错误文本，只保留事件类型与音效。隐私风格下不启用交互式通知，因为选项标签和问题文本同样属于内容。
- 点击链接使用白名单校验：只允许 `http:`、`https:`、`dsh:`；拒绝 `file:`、`javascript:`、`ms-msdt:` 等其他协议。
- HTTP 路由仅同源可用，校验 `Origin`，请求体上限 256 KiB。

dsh-system-notify README · Windows 没有弹窗：1. 检查 Windows **设置 → 系统 → 通知** 是否允许“DeepSeek Harness”。
2. 检查专注助手 / 勿扰模式；某些模式下通知只进通知中心，不显示横幅。
3. 确认插件与对应事件已启用。
4. 默认 AppID 为 `com.deepseek.dsh`，由 DSH 桌面版 Start Menu 快捷方式注册；助手会回退到其他已注册 Toast 源，最后回退到始终注册的 Windows PowerShell Toast 源。需要时可在设置中显式指定 `windows.appId`。

dsh-system-notify README · Windows 没有声音：- 自定义音效必须是本地 **WAV**；OGG/MP3 不会播放。
- 检查系统音量与输出设备。
- 先用设置页的“试听音效”；如果能响，问题在事件音效选择。

dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu 没有声音：- 安装 `pulseaudio-utils`（`paplay`），或确认存在 `pw-play`。
- 系统音效文件 `/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga` 不存在时会回退到内置提示音。

dsh-system-notify README · Ubuntu 没有通知：- 需要正在运行的通知守护进程（GNOME Shell、KDE、dunst、mako 等）；纯 SSH 无桌面会话不会显示。
- 安装 `libnotify-bin`；设置页会显示检测到的后端。

dsh-system-notify README · 点击没有唤起 DSH：- Windows：需要安装 DSH 桌面版，使 `dsh://` 协议存在。可在“运行”对话框输入 `dsh://open` 验证。
- Ubuntu：安装 `wmctrl`/`xdotool` 与 `libglib2.0-bin`；确认窗口标题包含 `click.focusWindowTitle`。
- 网页版 DSH：把 `click.url` 改成 DSH 网页地址。

dsh-system-notify README · 交互按钮没有反应：- 确认 **设置 → 系统通知 → 交互式通知** 已开启，且对应事件已勾选。
- Windows：设置页会显示协议状态；如果为 `✗`，确认当前用户可以写 `HKCU\Software\Classes`（无需管理员），然后重新加载插件。
- Ubuntu：安装 `libglib2.0-bin`（gdbus/dbus-monitor）；文本/勾选需要 `zenity`。
- 通知守护进程可能限制按钮数量；此时仍可使用 **打开 DSH**。
- 默认 20 秒后会由 DSH 正常界面接手，Agent 不会一直等待。

dsh-system-notify README · 自定义音效上传失败：- Windows 仅 WAV；Ubuntu 支持 WAV/OGG；最大 5 MiB。
- 文件按 magic bytes 校验，改扩展名无效。
- 配置目录不可写时会失败；检查设置页底部的配置路径。

dsh-system-notify README · 仍然没有解决：- 设置页点“发送测试通知”“试听音效”。
- 查看设置页底部的配置文件路径。
- 在 Host 环境设置 `DSH_SYSTEM_NOTIFY_DRY_RUN=1`，只记录将要发送的内容而不真正发送。
- 查看 DSH Host 日志里的 `[dsh-system-notify]` 警告。

dsh-system-notify README · 限制：- 交互式审批只支持“同意一次”或“拒绝”，没有“总是允许”按钮。
- 一次多个问题、或通知守护进程隐藏操作按钮时，会回落到 DSH 聊天界面。
- macOS 不支持交互式操作，只提供普通通知。
- Windows 通知音量由系统音效方案控制；`sound.volume` 仅对 Ubuntu 生效。
- Windows 自定义音效仅 WAV；上传后按绝对路径引用。
- 点击只聚焦 DSH 主窗口，不定位到具体会话（DSH 深链为 `dsh://open`）。
- Linux 点击/交互依赖 `gdbus`、`dbus-monitor` 和实现 freedesktop 规范的通知守护进程；文本/勾选需要 `zenity`。
- macOS 为尽力支持，点击需要 `terminal-notifier`。
- 系统专注模式可能抑制横幅，这是操作系统行为。
